risks.if_unproven: Price as an unidentified used engine (worst case: not confirmed compatible and not confirmed working).

risks.risk: Running condition not proven; engine may be defective, incomplete, or damaged internally.

risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / unknown condition.

risks.risk: Missing parts or mismatched accessories (alternator/AC compressor/hoses/sensors) not visible in this single angle.
risks.proof: Photos of the full engine from multiple sides showing all accessories and sensor connectors; also a checklist of included parts.

risks.risk: Guarantee may be verbal only or limited; terms not shown.
risks.proof: A written guarantee document (dated) stating duration, what is covered, and return/refund process.

risks.risk: Potential scam/low-trust listing: seller’s text is specific but photos don’t verify identity or condition.
risks.proof: Proof of ownership and source (e.g., receipt/vehicle details) plus the engine code photo.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest end for unknown used engines.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the engine code/ID plate (and any stamped code) so we can confirm the exact Camry engine variant.
Video of the engine starting and running (show idle and that it stays on).
Photos of the engine from all sides showing all sensors/connectors and accessories; confirm what is included.
Written guarantee terms (dated) and what happens if it fails.
response.reason: The photo shows an engine assembly, but it does not confirm it is a Toyota Camry or the exact engine variant, nor does it prove running condition or guarantee terms. Without those, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
